text:
marie: deploy-bot auto-paused the rollout at 60% for eu-west — p95 jumped to ~450ms, sustained for 7m :alarm_clock:
deploy-bot: Rollout paused. Target: eu-west. Current: 60%. Alert: p95 450ms (+200ms).
oleg: dashboards show the spike concentrated on nodes with new kernel flag KERN_FAST_PATH enabled.
priya: any user errors or just latency? we need business impact to decide revert vs pin.
sam: no errors reported, but throughput for heavy-traffic customers degraded. SLA exposure if it continues.
marie: proposal: manual rollback to v3.1.4 and pin the region; avoid auto-revert because metric was near threshold earlier and could flip.
oleg: agree, manual rollback + pin. I'll prepare the rollback command.
priya: log retention note: capture kvcache histograms and kernel boot params before nodes rotate.
oleg: executing: `rwctl rollout set --region eu-west --version v3.1.4 --pin --reason "p95 regression"`
deploy-bot: Command accepted. Staged unwind: 60% -> 30% over 2m, then 30% -> 0% over 4m.
sam: opening a short bridge and will monitor traces. keep it open for 45m.
marie: drafting internal blurb: "Emergency pin to v3.1.4 in eu-west due to p95 regression; investigating KERN_FAST_PATH interactions with kv eviction."
priya: I'll prepare customer-facing template for CS and Legal, highlighting that no data loss occurred and we're prioritizing enterprise customers.
oleg: after rollback finishes we'll replay the failing prompt set in staging with KV debug enabled: `KV_DEBUG=1 ./ci/replay.sh regress-suite-09`
deploy-bot: Rollout update: at 30% — p95 trending down to 230ms.
sam: metrics look stable at 15m post-rollback. keeping pin until a root cause is found.
marie: do not auto-unpin. we want a validated patch or kernel rollback before restoring traffic.
priya: creating incident ticket with timeline, commands run, and initial hypothesis. tagging eng-runtime and eng-sre.
oleg: adding traces, kernel config diffs, and kv eviction snapshots to the ticket.
deploy-bot: Rollout complete. Target version v3.1.4 pinned in eu-west.
sam: closing bridge in 30m if no regressions. will escalate otherwise.
marie: thanks all — solid rapid response. remember to include a checklist for the postmortem: detection, decision, exec commands, comms, follow-up fixes.
priya: will update incident doc and send CS/Legal note after postmortem link is available.
